description.zh:
JSON格式{height:xxx,scale:xxx,gop:xxx,bframes:xxx,cdesc:xxx}，所有字段均必填，缺少其中任意字段会调用失败。

> 具体参数请参考下表**CustomTemplate说明**。
description.en:
The template configuration in JSON format. The value must be in the following format: {height:xxx,scale:xxx,gop:xxx,bframes:xxx,cdesc:xxx}. All fields are required. The call fails if any field is missing.

> For more information about the parameters, see the **CustomTemplate details** table below.

description.zh:
需要添加的模板名。
>请在创建时记录模板名，用于使用、查询和删除操作。
description.en:
The name of the template to add.

> Record the template name after you create it. The name is required for subsequent operations, such as using, querying, and deleting the template.

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口创建好自定义模板后，请记录模板名。通过[CreateMixStream接口](~~2848087~~)创建合流任务时，MixStreamTemplate传入模板名来使用自定义模板。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
After you call this operation to create a custom template, record the template name. To use the custom template, set the MixStreamTemplate parameter to the template name when you call the [CreateMixStream](~~2848087~~) operation to create a stream mixing task.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 for each user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which can affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-custom-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --custom-template height_:_1060_,_scale_:_16:9_,_gop_:_60_,_bframes_:_30_,_cdesc_:_h264 --template TestTemplate --region cn-hangzhou
